snippet.title: Global Parity — Announcement Trailer | Grand Strategy Game
snippet.description:
Lead any nation. Every decision has a price.

Global Parity is a grand strategy game about running a country — inspired by SuperPower 2, Hearts of Iron IV and Geopolitical Simulator. Take control of one of 199 real-world nations in 2020, or a fictional world in 1999, and guide it for twenty years.

▶ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4877290/Global_Parity/
What you'll do:
• Run the economy — taxes, budget, inflation, a central bank and a world market
• Govern at home — pass laws through parliament, win elections, survive crises
• Deal with the world — treaties, sanctions, international organizations, ultimatums
• Wage war on a living front line — battles, generals, terrain and the peace conference that follows
• Face story events and a world that reacts — and reports it all in the news

Coming soon to Steam Early Access.

Developer: Solo indie developer

Music: "Five Armies" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Sound effects: Kenney (kenney.nl), OpenGameArt and Freesound contributors (CC0).

#GlobalParity #GrandStrategy #IndieGame #Strategy #Gamedev
